title: shift2eu assessment report, version 2
description: The JSON report of one inventory assessed against one target.

inventoryName.description: The inventory file's base name, or empty when it did not come from a file.

source.description: The source the inventory was taken from.

region.description: The region chosen for the target (--region or the API's regions), written only when one was chosen, with or without estimates. Absent when none was chosen.

resources.description: One verdict per resource, in the inventory's order.

blockers.description: One entry per reason a resource cannot move, in resource order.

workloads.description: One group per workload, by name in byte order, then the group without a workload; empty when there is no resource.

target.description: The target assessed against and its catalog snapshot.

snapshot.description: Where the target's catalog was taken from and when.

source.description: The snapshot's source URL, as stored.

retrieved.description: The UTC calendar date the snapshot was retrieved, YYYY-MM-DD.

summary.description: The number of resources per fit, and in total.

rawType.description: The source's own type name, or empty.

fit.description: How well the best offering fits.

bestOffering.description: The best candidate offering's name, or empty when there is none.

ties.description: The other candidates with the best one's fit and as many missing capabilities, in candidate order.

requiredChanges.description: For a partial fit, the capabilities the best offering lacks; empty otherwise.

relations.description: The resource's relations, in the inventory's order.

affectedBy.description: The IDs of the resources this one depends on or is a replica of that have no fit here, sorted; not transitive.

reason.description: One reason: a code, its plain sentence, and the names it mentions, each present only when set.

code.description: The reason code; a consumer must accept a code it does not know.

text.description: The reason as a plain sentence, not Markdown.

target.description: The target display name the reason mentions.

category.description: The taxonomy category the reason mentions.

offering.description: The offering name the reason mentions.

blocker.description: One reason a resource cannot move.

relation.description: One relation of the resource to another resource of the inventory.

type.description: The relation type, in the inventory's vocabulary (such as depends-on or replica-of); a consumer must accept a type it does not know.

target.description: The ID of the resource the relation points to.

plan.description: The plan the estimate chose or, when no plan is large enough, the largest plan of the best offerings.

name.description: The plan's name, as the catalog lists it.

memoryGiB.description: The plan's memory in GiB, an exact decimal with at most three fractional digits.

includedStorageGiB.description: The storage the plan includes, in GiB.

price.description: The plan's monthly list price in EUR in the estimate region, a decimal string rounded to the cent; absent when the plan has no price there.

resourceEstimate.description: The resource's monthly estimate: the amount, its breakdown and what it assumed when it is estimated, the reason when it is not. A resource that is not estimated is never counted as 0.

amount.description: The monthly list price in EUR, excluding VAT and discounts, a decimal string rounded to the cent (half away from zero); present only when estimated.

countAssumed.description: Whether the estimate assumed a count of 1 because the resource gives none; present only when estimated.

hoursAssumed.description: Whether the estimate assumed 730 hours a month because the resource gives none; present only when estimated.

billingCapHours.description: The most hours a month the estimated plan is billed for: its offering caps the billed hours of its plans, so the plan costs price × count × min(hours, billingCapHours) / billingCapHours (ADR 0029); present only when estimated by plan on a capped offering.

reason.description: Why the resource is not estimated (no-fit, usage-priced, no-size, no-plan, no-plan-large-enough, no-price, no-storage-price); present only when not estimated. A consumer must accept a reason it does not know.

breakdown.description: What an estimate is made of, each part in EUR as a decimal string rounded to the cent; each part is rounded from its exact value, so the parts sum to the amount give or take a cent.

plan.description: The plan price × count × hours a month / 730; 0.00 for a resource priced by storage.

storage.description: The storage priced per GiB, never scaled by hours.

fixedFee.description: The offering's listed fixed fee × hours a month / 730, once per resource and never × count; 0.00 when the offering charges none. A fee the catalog records as the smallest paid size of a tier (such as Scaleway Kubernetes Kapsule Dedicated, see the Scaleway catalog's SOURCES.md) is a lower bound of what the resource is charged.

total.description: A sum of estimates: the amount over the estimated resources only, how many those are, and how many resources there are.

amount.description: The sum in EUR, a decimal string rounded to the cent from the exact sum of the estimates, not summed from the rounded amounts of the resources, so it can differ from that by a cent or so.

resources.description: How many resources there are, estimated or not.

estimateBasis.description: What the estimates are given on, and their total. Present only when estimates are on.

region.description: The target region the prices are for.

regionChosen.description: True when the region was chosen (--region or the API's regions); false when it is the target's default region for estimates.

priceDate.description: The UTC calendar date the catalog's prices were retrieved, YYYY-MM-DD.

excluded.description: What the list prices leave out.

hoursBasis.description: The hours a month a plan price is for: a plan is priced price × count × hours / hoursBasis. A plan on an offering that caps its billed hours carries billingCapHours in its resource's estimate and costs price × count × min(hours, billingCapHours) / billingCapHours instead (ADR 0029).

sourceCost.description: What the source charges a month, per currency, never converted. Present only when estimates are on.

covered.description: How many resources the inventory gives a cost for.

resources.description: How many resources there are, with a cost or not.

currencies.description: One sum per currency, by currency code in byte order.

currencyCost.description: The source's monthly cost in one currency.

currency.description: The ISO 4217 code, as the inventory gives it.

amount.description: The sum in that currency, a decimal string rounded to the cent from the exact sum of the source costs.

resources.description: How many resources have a cost in that currency.

workload.description: The assessment of one workload: the resources that name it, or, for noWorkload, those that name none.

name.description: The workload's name, its runs of white space collapsed to one space; empty for the group without a workload.

noWorkload.description: True for the group of the resources that name no workload.

resources.description: How many resources the group holds.

blockers.description: The blockers of the group's resources, in resource order.
